decision.title: The Sun Sessions (1976)
tracklist: I Don't Care If the Sun Don't Shine
I'm Left, You're Right, She's Gone
I Forgot to Remember to Forget
I'll Never Let You Go (Little Darlin')

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (16 tracks) per https://www.discogs.com/release/1729944-Elvis-Presley-The-Sun-Sessions, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_songs_recorded_by_Elvis_Presley_on_the_Sun_label. 1976 RCA compilation (APM1-1675) of Sun Records masters; 16 of the 24 known Sun titles, including two versions of 'I Love You Because' (labelled '1st Version' / '2nd Version'). Previously issued in the UK in 1975 as 'The Sun Collection'. Sequence identical across Discogs US LP, Wikipedia, Last.fm and herbmusic listings.
